snippet.title: Fortnite Battle Royale Chapter Seven: Pacific Break | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description: Chapter Seven: Pacific Break is live now! Switch up your strats with new mechanics like Simple Build and Self-Revive, take to the air with the Wingsuit, and choose your own unlock path in the revamped Battle Pass. While the Battle Bus is out of commission, you'll Storm Surf your way to the Island instead! Catch you on the Golden Coast.
